articles.author: Godfrey
articles.description:
Hey everyone 
My name is Godfrey, but you can call me BGOD.
I’m a 19-year-old Nigerian with a big dream — to rise from nothing, learn powerful tech skills, and build a future filled with purpose, impact, and financial freedom.
Right now, I don’t have much — not even a laptop yet — but I have vision, hunger, and faith. I created this account to document my journey from zero to pro, learning software development and cybersecurity step-by-step, using just my phone.
I believe in growing in public — sharing my wins, mistakes, lessons, and breakthroughs. I want to inspire other people who feel they’re starting from the bottom, to remind them: we can rise from dust and still touch the sky.
Over the next weeks, I’ll be learning:
Basic HTML, CSS, and JavaScript
How to use GitHub
Cybersecurity fundamentals
How to build a business portfolio as a tech creator
If you're also learning, struggling, or starting — let’s connect. Let’s grow together.
This is my beginning, and I’m not stopping.

Let’s build. 
**#beginners #learninginpublic #Nigeria #devjourney #cybersecurity #softwaredevelopment.
